title: Brand Guidelines
intro: These guidelines keep our communication **consistent** across print and digital.

chapters.title: Logo
chapters.text: Always use the master artwork supplied by the design team.
rules: Keep a clear space equal to the height of the logo mark
Never stretch or recolour the logo

sections.title: Colour variants
sections.text: Use the full-colour logo on light backgrounds and the white logo on dark ones.

chapters.title: Colour
chapters.text: Our palette has three primary colours.

blocks.text: Headings use *Myriad Pro*; body text uses *Minion Pro*.
Never use more than two weights on one page
